title: Founder Institute — Global Chapters (Local, Silicon Valley & San Francisco)
summary: The world's largest pre-seed startup accelerator with structured weekly sprints, tough mentor grading, and global investor access. Creator personally recommends finding your local chapter or applying to Silicon Valley or San Francisco.
keyTakeaway: External weekly accountability and blunt mentor feedback compress 12 months of solo wandering into 14 focused weeks.

title: FI One-Sentence Pitch (Madlibs + Secret Sauce Framework)
summary: The classic buzzword-free Madlibs formula forcing crystal clarity on offering, exact target audience, problem solved, and Secret Sauce differentiator.
keyTakeaway: If you cannot explain who pays you and why in one jargon-free sentence, you are not ready to code or pitch.

title: FI Pitch Deck Templates (Problem-Solution & Traction Formats)
summary: Strict 10-word-max headlines, max 3 bullets per slide, 1-to-1 Problem-to-Solution mirroring, and quantified proof built for 3-minute mentor & investor pitches.
keyTakeaway: Slides are visual billboards supporting your voice, never dense documents.

title: FI FAST Agreement (Founder/Advisor Standard Template)
summary: Standardized legal framework for granting 0.15%–1.00% advisory equity over 2-year vesting with a 3-month trial cliff tied to concrete monthly hours and deliverables.
keyTakeaway: Never give unvested advisor equity; always run a 30-day work trial and tie equity to measurable intros or output.

title: FI For-Progress Framework & UN SDG iKPIs
summary: Turns the 17 UN Sustainable Development Goals into concrete, measurable Impact KPIs (iKPIs) that for-profit startups track right alongside MRR and gross profit.
keyTakeaway: Ethical profit and measurable societal progress compound together—never treat impact as an afterthought.

title: VC Lab by Decile Group — The Mensarius Oath
summary: The ethical code of conduct for top-decile venture capital and ethical founders: integrity, transparency, fairness, confidentiality, zero harm, and positive stakeholder outcomes.
keyTakeaway: Build massive profit through 10x genuine customer value—never through dark patterns or deception.

title: VC Lab / Decile Group — PACT Written Commitment Discipline
summary: Converts vague verbal praise ('keep me posted!') into concrete, 1-page written intent commitments with explicit dollar amounts and target close dates.
keyTakeaway: Use PACT discipline for BOTH Customer Paid-Pilot commitments (fast cash) and Investor Soft-Circles (predictable closes).

title: The Mom Test — How to Talk to Customers Without Getting Polite Lies
summary: The gold-standard guide to unbiased customer discovery: never pitch your idea early; ask about past behavior, real dollars/hours wasted, and ugly workarounds already in use.
keyTakeaway: Compliments are worthless; only past spend, time commitments, or paid deposits prove real buyer pain.

title: Sean Ellis 40% Rule & Superhuman Product-Market Fit Engine
summary: Quantifies PMF by asking active users how they would feel if your product disappeared (>=40% 'Very Disappointed' = PMF), narrowing to your High-Expectation Customer (HXC), and executing a 50/50 roadmap.
keyTakeaway: Never pour paid marketing spend into a <40% leaky bucket; narrow ICP to the segment that already loves you.

title: Do Things That Don't Scale
summary: Why the best startups recruit their first 10–50 customers manually, deliver concierge onboarding, and delight early adopters obsessively before automating.
keyTakeaway: Manual concierge delivery for customers #1–#10 gets you to First Dollar in days instead of months.

title: Default Alive or Default Dead?
summary: The classic profitability survival test: assuming current growth and burn stay constant, will your startup reach profitability before cash runs out?
keyTakeaway: Default-Alive founders keep maximum equity and negotiate with investors from strength, never desperation.

title: Y Combinator Post-Money SAFE Financing Documents
summary: Standardized open-source Simple Agreement for Future Equity (SAFE) templates and user guide for transparent, low-legal-cost pre-seed/seed fundraising.
keyTakeaway: Always model post-money SAFE dilution across multiple rounds via financial_calc(mode='cap_table_model') before signing.

title: Stripe Atlas — Delaware C-Corp Incorporation & 83(b) Workflow
summary: Investor-standard US Delaware C-Corp formation, EIN, founder stock issuance with guided 30-day IRS 83(b) election filing, and instant Stripe payments readiness.
keyTakeaway: Incorporate cleanly once customer PACTs or revenue validate demand—avoid messy DIY cap tables.

title: QuickBooks Online — Founder Bookkeeping & Investor-Ready Financials
summary: Cloud bookkeeping for clean P&L, Balance Sheet, cash-flow tracking, and effortless CPA handoff. Connects directly to Antigravity via Zapier MCP, Intuit QBO MCP, or Intuit CLI.
keyTakeaway: Clean books from Dollar #1 save weeks during Seed due diligence and keep gross margin truth visible daily.

title: Intuit Official QuickBooks Online MCP Server & CLI
summary: Official open-source MCP server (140+ QBO tools + 11 financial reports with read-only flag) and companion CLI for safe AI bookkeeping inside Antigravity.
keyTakeaway: Run in read-only mode first and always require explicit founder approval before posting any QuickBooks write.

title: Replit — All-in-One Design Mode, Web, Expo Mobile, Hosting & Slides
summary: Start visually in Replit Design Mode, code locally in Antigravity to avoid double token burn, and sync via private GitHub into Replit's Free tier for Web apps, Expo Go mobile QR previews, DB/Secrets, and Replit Slides.
keyTakeaway: Eliminate Docker, AWS, and Xcode friction while staying on the free tier until paying customers fund upgrades.

title: Dipity Studio / Sera — AI Executive Second Brain & Brand Content Engine
source: Dipity Studio by FI Mentor & Grad Morgan Von Druitt
summary: Turns weekly founder voice notes and Startup Antigravity's docs/DIPITY_BRAND_BRAIN.md into authentic LinkedIn, X, newsletter, blog, and Gen Studio visual content with API & MCP support.
keyTakeaway: Founder-led authentic content compounds inbound trust and lowers CAC without paid ad burn.

title: Shelled AI — Coordinated Multi-Agent Engineering & PR Platform
source: Shelled AI by FI Silicon Valley AI Grad Jacob Wellinghoff
summary: Orchestrates specialist AI agents (architects, coders, testers, reviewers) over shared repo context—local, cloud, or private/on-prem—turning specs into tested, reviewed Pull Requests.
keyTakeaway: Sync docs/SHELLED_HANDOFF.md once PMF is validated to multiply engineering PR velocity cleanly.

title: Product Hunt Official Launch Guide
summary: Official rules, 12:01 AM PT launch timing, gallery image dimensions (1270x760), thumbnail specs (240x240), and anti-spam guidelines for high-converting Product Hunt debuts.
keyTakeaway: Never join upvote rings; focus on authentic maker storytelling, fast comment replies, and paid customer conversion.

title: Zapier — 9,000+ App Startup Workflow Automation (Antigravity Plugin)
summary: 1-click OAuth Antigravity partner plugin connecting QuickBooks Online, Stripe, Gmail, Slack, HubSpot, Notion, and Google Sheets directly into your Founder OS.
keyTakeaway: Automate repetitive back-office glue (Stripe -> QuickBooks -> Slack) instead of writing custom integration code.

title: Canva — Brand-Checked Pitch Decks & Launch Visuals (Antigravity Plugin)
summary: Official Antigravity partner plugin that turns pitch-deck/design-handoff/CANVA_DECK_BRIEF.md into polished presentations, brand-checked decks, and resized social/Product Hunt assets.
keyTakeaway: Lint your FI copy first in deck.json, then let Canva elevate visual hierarchy and export PDF/PPTX.

title: Figma & Figma Slides — Product Wireframes & Token-Driven Decks (Antigravity Plugin)
summary: Official Antigravity partner plugin turning FIGMA_SLIDES_BRIEF.md + W3C FIGMA_TOKENS.json into native 1920x1080 Figma Slides and converting approved Figma UI wireframes straight into MVP code.
keyTakeaway: Use Figma when you want one shared design-token system across your pitch deck, landing page, and production app.

title: Value-Based Pricing (10x ROI Rule) & SaaS Packaging Guide
summary: Price anchored to measurable customer ROI (typically 10% of value created) rather than cost-plus, with 3 clean tiers and annual upfront discounts to pull cash forward.
keyTakeaway: Raising price 2x with 10x customer ROI doubles profit velocity faster than any growth hack.

title: SaaS Metrics 2.0 — CAC, LTV, Payback & Burn Multiple
summary: The definitive breakdown of SaaS unit economics: gross-margin-adjusted LTV, LTV:CAC >= 3:1, CAC payback < 12 months (< 6 mo for capital-efficient velocity), and negative churn.
keyTakeaway: Always run financial_calc(mode='unit_economics') before scaling acquisition spend.

title: Bottom-Up TAM/SAM/SOM Market Sizing Method
summary: Calculate market size strictly bottom-up (Verifiable Buyer Count x Realistic Annual ACV x Capture %) using Census NAICS, regulatory registries, or LinkedIn counts—never '1% of $1T'.
keyTakeaway: Bottom-up sizing immediately reveals whether you have a $1B+ VC-scale market or a high-profit bootstrap cash cow.

title: Obviously Awesome — Positioning & Competitive Wedge
summary: Step-by-step positioning framework: list true competitive alternatives (including spreadsheets/do nothing), isolate unique attributes, map to customer value, and claim the right market category.
keyTakeaway: Great positioning makes your value obvious inside 5 seconds on your landing page and Slide 1.

title: IRS 83(b) Election 30-Day Filing Rule (Founder Tax Hygiene)
summary: Explains the strict, non-extendable 30-day IRS deadline to file an 83(b) election upon receiving restricted founder or advisor stock—preventing catastrophic future tax bills.
keyTakeaway: Missing the 30-day 83(b) window cannot be undone—confirm immediately with qualified startup counsel.

title: Ollama — 100% Local, $0-Token Private AI Models
summary: Run open-weight LLMs locally on Windows, macOS, or Linux at $0 per token—plugs directly into Startup Antigravity's ai_connectors_manage for private drafting and low-COGS prototyping.
keyTakeaway: Use local models for high-volume drafts or sensitive customer-note synthesis to keep burn near zero.

title: US Census County Business Patterns (NAICS Buyer Count Data)
summary: Authoritative primary-source counts of US establishments by NAICS industry code and employee size—ideal for turning [HYPOTHESIS] TAM counts into [VALIDATED] investor proof.
keyTakeaway: Citing primary Census/registry counts immediately separates credible founders from hand-wavers.

title: Traction — 19 Distribution Channels & Bullseye Framework
summary: Systematic method to brainstorm all 19 acquisition channels, test the top 3 cheaply in parallel, and focus 100% on the single Bullseye channel that delivers lowest CAC.
keyTakeaway: Spend 50% of your week on product and 50% on traction—great products die silently without distribution.

title: VC Lab / FI Monthly Investor Update Cadence
summary: Short (<250 word), radically honest monthly updates (TL;DR, Verified Metrics, Top 3 Highlights, Lowlights/Risks, Specific Asks) that turn passive observers into lead investors.
keyTakeaway: Investors invest in lines, not dots—run sprint_manage(action='investor_update') every month like clockwork.

title: Cloudflare Pages & Netlify — $0 Static Hosting for 48-Hour Smoke Tests
summary: Instant, free global CDN hosting for deploying Startup Antigravity's landing/index.html smoke-test page and pitch-deck/index.html in under 60 seconds.
keyTakeaway: Never pay for cloud servers just to test an offer—ship landing/index.html free and close Customer PACTs first.
